_comment: Copy to config/settings.json (gitignored) to change any of these. Every key is optional: leave one out and its default applies. No code changes or rebuild needed - hit Refresh.
_localUtcOffsetHours: Transcript timestamps are UTC; days are bucketed at this offset so 'today' matches your calendar. Leave it out to use this machine's current offset. Pin it (e.g. 0 for UTC, 5.5, -7) if the machine's zone is not the one you think in, or to stop daylight-saving switches shifting a few hours between days. Changing it re-buckets days going forward; days already in data/ keep the offset they were archived with.
_weekStartsOn: First row of the activity heat map: "monday", "sunday" or "saturday".
_maxIdleGapMinutes: Runtime is the sum of wall-clock gaps between consecutive log lines in a session. A gap longer than this is assumed to be you stepping away, and is excluded.
_suspiciousOutputTokens: After de-duplication, a message from a real model whose output_tokens is below this - despite substantial input/cache context - is flagged 'possibly inaccurate'.
_suspiciousContextTokens: Minimum input+cache_read tokens for the low-output flag to apply. Prevents flagging genuinely tiny turns.
